statement.heading: An independent studio
statement.body: Marsad is an independent studio building small, focused worlds instead of sprawling ones. Every game starts from a single idea worth years of work, and stays in development until it's worth the time it asks of the people who play it.

About.heading: About Marsad
About.intro: How we build, and why we build it this way.
paragraphs: Marsad builds small, focused worlds instead of sprawling ones. That's not a resource constraint dressed up as a philosophy — it's the actual bet: that a game built around one idea, followed all the way through, ends up more worth a player's time than ten ideas each explored halfway. Every project here starts from a single mechanic, mood, or question, and stays in development until that one thing is done right.

Most games made for Arabic-speaking players are translated into Arabic after the fact — built in English, then localised. Marsad works the other way around. Arabic is the language the studio designs in first: the wordmark, the interface, the pacing of a sentence in a menu. English comes second, as a genuine second language for the games, not a set of subtitles bolted onto an English original. It changes real decisions — how much space a heading needs, how a layout mirrors, which words actually fit a button — not just which font renders.
None of this makes a game good by itself. It just means every game that reaches a player has already been through a studio that treats craft, and the language it's built in, as the same decision.

Support.heading: Support
Support.intro: Have a question, found a bug, or want to talk business? Email us directly — there's no form, no ticket system, just a real inbox.

faq.question: How do I report a bug?
faq.answer: Email us with your device, the game you were playing, and what happened — the more specific, the faster we can help. A screenshot or a short clip makes a big difference.

faq.question: How do I request a refund?
faq.answer: Refunds are handled by whichever store you bought the game from — the App Store, Google Play, or similar — since they process the payment, not us. If you bought directly from us and it isn't resolved there, email us and we'll sort it out.

faq.question: Press or business inquiries?
faq.answer: Same address. Put "press" or "partnership" in the subject line and it'll reach the right person faster.
